_readme: Voice casting for `s2c voices`. Every speaking character maps to an ElevenLabs voice_id.
The voices below are ElevenLabs premade voices, present in every account.
Fields: voice_id, name (label only), public_owner_id (to auto-add a Voice Library voice the first time),
model / settings (override the defaults), pitch_semitones (ffmpeg pitch shift: younger selves, copies),
tempo (0.85 = 15% slower, pitch kept), fx (radio | offscreen | ethereal | abyss | distant),
alias (inherit another character's voice and override some fields).
Characters found in the script but missing here are assigned an unused voice from `pool` and written back.
defaults.speak_int_ext: false reads 'INT. HARBOR OFFICE - NIGHT' as 'Harbor Office. Night.'
defaults.cue_aliases folds spellings a draft drifted through, e.g. {"YOUNGER MIRA": "YOUNG MIRA"}.
